[[Timothy Flenning|Timothy]] (son) }} '''Judith Flenning''' is a [[human]] quest ender located in the [[Ambershire]] town hall in [[Northwind]]. She lived in Ambershire with her children [[Sara Flenning|Sara]] and [[Timothy Flenning|Timothy]]. While Judith was away from the house, Sara and Timothy were kidnapped{{questlong|Alliance|28|Empty Houses}} by orcs of the [[Stormreaver clan]] that sought to take them to their hideout on the island of [[Balor]]. Tragically, Sara was killed by the Stormreavers before she could be rescued, and her body was later retrieved by [[Operative Baltimore Hawthorne]] of [[SI:7]].{{questlong|Alliance|34|Shadow's Vision}} Timothy, along with many other captives, was experimented upon by the Stormreavers, resulting in his body liquifying and dissolving into ooze. Timothy's remains were later absorbed into the [[Remains of the Innocent]], deep beneath [[Stormwrought Castle]]. Upon the destruction of the amalgamation, all that was left of Timothy was his [[Etched Toy Sword]].{{questlong|Alliance|38|All That Is Left}} ==Quests== * {{questlong|Alliance|38|All That Is Left}} {{questfinish}} ==Quotes== :''Main article: [[Empty Houses#Notes]]'' :''Main article: [[Deathcap And Widow's Frill#Notes]]'' ;Gossip ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.18.0|note=Added.}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Flenning, Judith}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Quest enders]] [[Category:Northwind NPCs]] [[Category:Stormwind (kingdom)]]
